column1: ;; The core operation table: one row per CoreFnId variant, in sections. The
;; module docs of src/core_operations.rs define the type classes, every column
;; and the conditions a pass relies on; tests/compiler/core_operations.rs checks
;; value:     type of the core value itself.
;; params:    call signatures, one bracketed arity each, `&` before the rest type;
;;            `-` when no call is described. Types are classes joined by `|`, or
;;            the aliases scalar, coll (runtime collections) and seqable.
;;            `[fn]:fn` narrows the result type of one arity. `fn(e1)(...)`
;;            is a callback shape: the arguments of each call the operation
;;            makes of that function, from aN (argument N), eN (an element of
;;            it), rN (what function argument N returns), aN+ and eN+ (from N
;;            on) and types. A function argument without one escapes.
;; returns:   result type of a call within params, then optionally the type of
;;            the elements of the seqs, lists, vectors and sets it returns:
;; purity:    pure, allocates, throws or effect, for calls within params.
;; calls:     code the arguments supply that the call may run: -, dispatch
;;            or invoke (dispatch, and it calls its function arguments).
;; units:     runtime units that define the value; rewrite them after moving
;; Dynamic vars and settable values (a program may rebind or set! them)
;; Protocol method dispatchers: they run whatever implementation the value has
;; Hierarchies and multimethods (global and per-multimethod mutable state)

column4: [] [any any] [any any any any] [any any any any any any] [any any any any any any any any]
[] [any any] [any any any any] [any any any any any any] [any any any any any any any any]
[seqable] [any seqable] [any any seqable] [any any any seqable]

[number seqable] [number number seqable] [number number any seqable]
[map|set fn any] [map|set fn any fn any]
[map|set fn any] [map|set fn any fn any]
[fn any] [fn any any] [fn any any any]
